results.replacement_mermaid:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
  Browser["Browser: POST /api/langgraph/threads/{thread_id}/runs/stream"] --> Nginx["docker/nginx: rewrite /api/langgraph/* to /api/*"]
  Nginx --> StreamRoute["thread_runs.stream_run(thread_id, body, request)"]

  StreamRoute --> StartRun["services.start_run"]
  StartRun --> RuntimeCtx["deps.get_run_context: checkpointer/store/event_store/thread_store/live AppConfig"]
  StartRun --> Validate["model allowlist + thread_store.check_access"]
  Validate --> CreateRun["RunManager.create_or_reject: pending RunRecord or 409/501"]
  CreateRun --> ThreadMeta["thread_store.create/update_status('running')"]
  ThreadMeta --> Config["normalize_input + build_run_config + merge_run_context_overrides"]
  Config --> Task["asyncio.create_task(worker.run_agent)"]

  StreamRoute --> Response["StreamingResponse(text/event-stream) + Content-Location"]
  Response --> SseConsumer["services.sse_consumer"]
  SseConsumer --> Subscribe["MemoryStreamBridge.subscribe(run_id, Last-Event-ID)"]

  Task --> Running["run_agent: RunManager.set_status('running')"]
  Running --> Metadata["StreamBridge.publish('metadata', {run_id, thread_id})"]
  Metadata --> Agent["make_lead_agent + agent.astream(...)"]
  Agent --> Events["publish values/messages/custom/debug chunks"]
  Events --> Subscribe
  Subscribe --> SseFrames["format_sse(entry.event, entry.data, id)"]
  SseFrames --> Browser

  Agent --> Success["set_status('success')"]
  Agent --> Error["set_status('error') + publish('error')"]
  SseConsumer -->|"client disconnect + on_disconnect=cancel"| Cancel["RunManager.cancel(run_id)"]
  Cancel --> Interrupted["worker observes abort_event: interrupted or rollback error"]
  Success --> Cleanup["publish_end + bridge.cleanup(delay=60)"]
  Error --> Cleanup
  Interrupted --> Cleanup
  Cleanup --> EndSentinel["subscribe yields END_SENTINEL"]
  EndSentinel --> BrowserEnd["SSE event: end"]
```
